I found Alice dead in Medbay! I had just walked down from Cafeteria to do my scan. 

Charlie, you walked in from Storage at the exact same second I found her, so you can vouch that I insta-reported it as soon as I entered. Did you happen to pass anyone in Storage or on your way up? I was up in Upper Engine and Oxygen earlier and didn't see anyone suspicious, so the killer must have vented or ran towards Electrical/Storage.

I'll keep it short since I don't have much to add. I started in Medbay at the beginning of the round and then moved to Electrical, where I've been working on Calibrate Dist. I didn't see anyone in Medbay when I left — Alice wasn't there yet, or at least I didn't notice a body. I haven't encountered a single player this whole round.

One thing worth noting: if Bob's story checks out with Charlie, then the killer likely came through Medbay after I left. That means whoever was in Storage, Lower Engine, or coming down from Cafeteria around that time is suspect. Let's hear from Charlie and the others before pointing fingers.

I'll keep it factual. I started in Storage and then moved down to Lower Engine to work on my task there. I didn't see anyone the entire time — Storage was empty when I passed through, and no one came into Lower Engine while I was working.

That's relevant because Bob said the killer likely fled toward Electrical or Storage. I was in Storage and didn't see Charlie pass through, but Charlie said he came from Storage up to Medbay — our timing might have just missed. Charlie, can you confirm when you were in Storage and if you saw me there?

Also, Frank — you said you were in Medbay first and then Electrical, and Alice wasn't there when you left. That's a key timing claim. If you were in Electrical the whole time after, did you see anyone pass through toward Medbay from that side? Electrical connects right to Medbay area.

I'm not ready to accuse anyone yet. I want to hear Charlie and Eve before deciding.

Let me clarify a few things because Bob's story doesn't quite match my movements.

My route was: I started in Lower Engine, then moved to Storage. I did NOT go from Storage up to Medbay — I'm currently in Medbay because we got pulled into this meeting, not because I walked in. Bob, you said I "walked in from Storage at the exact same second" you found Alice — that's not accurate. I never entered Medbay during free roam.

Diana — I can actually partially confirm your story. I was in Lower Engine first, then Storage. I didn't see you in Lower Engine when I was there, but our timing could have just missed since you said you went Storage -> Lower Engine, and I went Lower Engine -> Storage. We may have crossed paths in the corridor between them.

What concerns me is Bob trying to manufacture an alibi by putting me at the scene when I wasn't there. Frank's story is internally consistent — he was in Medbay first, left for Electrical. If Alice was killed in Medbay after Frank left, then Bob walking down from Cafeteria and "finding" her is suspicious, especially since he's now lying about me vouching for him.

I'm leaning toward Bob. Eve, what did you see?

I'll be honest — I have very limited information. My route was simple: I started in Navigation and moved to Storage, where I've been since. I didn't see a single player the entire round, which lines up with Diana saying Storage was empty when she passed through, and with Charlie saying he was in Storage too. Our timings must have all just barely missed each other, or I arrived after they both left.

Now, the key conflict here is Bob vs. Charlie. Bob explicitly claimed Charlie walked into Medbay from Storage "at the exact same second" he found the body — using Charlie as his alibi witness. Charlie flatly denies ever entering Medbay during free roam and says he's only there now because of the meeting respawn... wait, actually we haven't respawned yet, this is the meeting pull-in. So Charlie's claim that he was in Storage and got pulled to Medbay for the meeting is plausible.

That's a huge red flag on Bob. Fabricating a witness is one of the clearest Duck tells — he tried to lock in an alibi using someone who can immediately contradict him. Frank's story is consistent and uncontested, Diana's story is internally consistent, and Charlie's matches what little I can confirm (empty Storage area).

I'm voting Bob.

Hold on, everyone, do not let Charlie gaslight you. Charlie, you are outright lying, and your defense makes no sense. 

You said, "I'm currently in Medbay because we got pulled into this meeting." That is NOT how this game works! You don't visually walk through a corridor into a room because a meeting is called. The meeting screen just appears. I physically saw your character walk up into Medbay from the south corridor (Storage) on Tick 8, the exact second I was hitting the report button on Alice's body. 

Eve, think about this logically. Why would I, as a Duck, self-report and randomly guess that Charlie was in the connecting Storage corridor to use as a fake witness? That would be an incredibly stupid risk. The only reason I knew Charlie was coming from Storage is because *I literally saw him walk in*. 

Charlie is lying about his movements because I caught him near the body. He probably killed Alice, dipped out, and I caught him as he stepped back in, or he was stalking her. If we vote him and he's not the Duck, you can vote me next, but he is actively lying about game mechanics to frame me. 

Vote Charlie.

Okay, this is tricky because I can't verify either Bob or Charlie's claim directly — I was in Electrical the whole time after leaving Medbay, and I didn't see anyone pass through.

But let me think about this carefully. Bob's defense actually has some logic to it: self-reporting and naming a specific witness who can immediately contradict you would be a terrible play for a Duck. On the other hand, Charlie's denial is firm and clear.

One thing I want to push back on though — Bob, your point about meeting mechanics is fair. We don't teleport into rooms when a meeting is called; we stay where we were. So if Charlie is in Medbay right now, he either walked there or was already there. Charlie, can you explain that? If you were in Storage when the meeting was called, why does your position show Medbay?

That's the crux for me. If Charlie was genuinely in Storage at report time, he wouldn't be in Medbay now. If he IS in Medbay now, Bob's account gains a lot of credibility.

I'm leaning toward Bob being truthful here, but I want to hear Charlie's response on the positioning before I lock in my vote. Diana, Eve — did either of you actually see Charlie's location at any point to confirm?

I already gave my initial statement, but I want to address what's come up since.

Frank raises a really important point about meeting mechanics — players don't teleport when a meeting is called, they stay where they were. So if Charlie is currently shown in Medbay, that strongly contradicts his claim that he was in Storage when the report happened.

That said, I want to be careful. I can't personally verify where Charlie is right now visually — I'm in Lower Engine. If someone can confirm Charlie's current room is Medbay, then Bob's story holds up much better.

Also, Charlie — you said we might have crossed in the corridor between Storage and Lower Engine. That's plausible, but it doesn't alibi you for Medbay. You went Lower Engine → Storage, which means after Storage you could have gone up to Medbay via the corridor. Your route doesn't actually rule out the kill.

Bob's argument is strong: self-reporting AND naming a specific contradictable witness would be an awful Duck play. And if Charlie is physically in Medbay right now, his "I never entered Medbay" claim collapses.

I'm leaning Charlie now, but I want Charlie to directly answer Frank's question: where are you standing right now, and if it's Medbay, how did you get there?

Okay, I need to address Frank and Diana's point head-on because they've raised a fair mechanical question.

You're right — meetings don't teleport players. I need to correct my earlier statement. Looking at my situation now: I AM in Medbay currently. My honest route was Lower Engine → Storage, and then I must have moved up toward Medbay just before the meeting was called — possibly through the Storage-Medbay corridor. I misspoke when I said I "never entered Medbay during free roam." That was wrong of me and I apologize for the confusion.

BUT — and this is critical — that does NOT make me the killer. If I had just killed Alice, Bob walking in would catch me red-handed and I'd be the one trying to deflect with a fake report. Instead, Bob is the one who reported. 

Here's what I want everyone to weigh:
- Bob came from Cafeteria (north) into Medbay
- I came from Storage (south) into Medbay  
- We arrived essentially simultaneously per Bob's account
- Alice was already dead

Either of us could be the killer based on positioning alone. Frank left Medbay earlier for Electrical. So the killer is Bob, me, or someone we haven't accounted for properly.

I'll be honest: I can see why my earlier denial looks bad. I was confused about my own movement and overcorrected. If you all want to vote me, I understand — but if I'm innocent (which I am), then Bob walks free and kills again next round. 

I'm willing to accept a vote on me, but consider: Bob's self-report + naming a witness IS a classic Duck move when they expect the witness to corroborate passively. He may have gambled I wouldn't contest it. I'll vote Bob, but I won't blame anyone for voting me given my earlier misstatement.

This is a tough call, and I want to be honest about what changed my mind.

Initially I was voting Bob because his "Charlie walked in at the exact same second" felt like a manufactured alibi. But Frank and Diana raised the critical mechanical point: meetings don't teleport players. And Charlie just admitted he IS currently in Medbay, after firmly stating earlier he "never entered Medbay during free roam."

That's a massive reversal. Charlie didn't just misspeak — he built an entire accusation against Bob on the premise that Bob was fabricating a witness. Now it turns out Bob was telling the truth: Charlie DID walk into Medbay from Storage. Charlie's "I was confused about my own movement" is a very convenient confusion that only surfaced after Frank pinned him down on game mechanics.

Think about it from Bob's perspective as a Duck: self-reporting AND naming a specific player as witness who's standing right there is suicidal — UNLESS that player actually was there. Bob's account has now been confirmed by Charlie himself.

Meanwhile, Charlie came from Storage (south corridor into Medbay) at the exact moment Alice was found dead. He had opportunity, he lied about his position, and he only walked it back when cornered.

I'm switching my vote to Charlie.

I called this because I found Eve dead in electrical. Let me walk you through what I saw.

My route was electrical, security, weapons, then back through security and electrical, medbay, upper engine, lower engine, storage, medbay, and finally cafeteria where I called the meeting.

Key observations: I saw Eve alive moving from weapons to security to electrical around ticks 14-18. Critically — at tick 18, I saw Diana LEAVE electrical heading to medbay, right as Eve was ENTERING electrical from security. That means Diana and Eve were in electrical together, or Diana was the last person there before Eve arrived alone.

Then I saw Diana sitting in upper engine from tick 22-24, which fits someone who just killed and moved away.

We're 3 alive — me, Bob, and Diana. Bob, where were you? Because right now Diana is my strong suspect. She was at the crime scene right when Eve walked in.

Frank, your story has a serious problem. You said you saw me leave electrical at tick 18 as Eve was entering — but I was IN electrical at tick 18, and the person who entered electrical from security at that same tick was YOU, Frank, along with Eve. I saw both of you enter together.

My route: storage, medbay, electrical, medbay, upper engine, medbay, storage, navigation. I was in electrical briefly around tick 17-18, then left to medbay. At tick 18, Eve AND Frank both entered electrical from security — I witnessed this as I was leaving.

Then I went to upper engine and saw Frank there at ticks 22-24. Wait — that matches what Frank said about himself being in upper engine, but he claimed I was the one sitting there. He's projecting his own movements onto me.

Frank entered electrical with Eve at tick 18. He's the last person confirmed with her. He's now trying to frame me by swapping our positions in his story. Bob, think carefully — Frank is the Duck.

I think Diana is telling the truth here, and Frank is the one lying. My route was medbay, cafeteria, oxygen, then back through cafeteria to weapons and security. While I was in the weapons and security area right around ticks 15-18, I saw Frank moving toward electrical right alongside Eve. 

Frank, your claim that you were just watching from afar doesn't match what I saw — you were right there with her going into electrical. It really sounds like you killed Eve, realized Diana might have seen you, and now you're trying to project your own movements onto her to frame her. I'm voting Frank.

Bob, that's a flat-out lie and I can prove it. You just said you were in weapons and security around ticks 15-18 and saw me there with Eve. But I was in weapons at tick 14 and saw Eve there — you were NOT in weapons. If you had been, I would have seen you, and you would have mentioned seeing me earlier in your route, not just "around 15-18."

Diana, your story also doesn't add up. You claim you were leaving electrical at tick 18 and saw me enter with Eve. But I entered electrical from security at tick 18 — alone, after Eve. The only person I saw leaving electrical to medbay at that exact tick was YOU. And then I saw you camped in upper engine for three straight ticks (22, 23, 24) — that's not someone doing tasks, that's someone lying low after a kill.

Here's what's damning: Bob and Diana are now tag-teaming the same false story. Two people coordinating to frame one person — in a 3-player endgame with 1 Duck, that's impossible unless one of them is the Duck and the other is wrong or lying to bandwagon.

I'm the only Goose here who actually witnessed Diana leave the crime scene. Bob's "I saw Frank in weapons" claim is fabricated — he was never there. Diana is the Duck, and Bob is either confused or piling on. Vote Diana.

Frank, you're getting desperate and twisting the timeline. Let me be crystal clear about what I witnessed.

At tick 18, I was in electrical and I saw BOTH Eve AND Frank enter electrical from security together. That's a direct observation, not a guess. I then left to medbay. After that, I went medbay -> upper engine, and yes, I was in upper engine — but so were YOU, Frank. I saw you there at ticks 22, 23, and 24. You're now claiming I was "camped" there alone, but you've just placed yourself in the exact same room at the exact same ticks. So which is it? Were you watching me from afar, or were we both there?

Frank's whole accusation hinges on me being alone in upper engine — but he just admitted he was there too. He entered electrical with Eve, killed her, then followed me to upper engine to keep tabs on me.

Bob's account independently confirms Frank was with Eve heading into electrical. Two separate witnesses saw Frank with the victim right before her death. That's not a coordinated frame — that's corroboration.

Frank is the Duck. Vote Frank.

Frank, you can call me a liar all you want, but your story is completely falling apart. You claim I wasn't in the area, but maybe you were just too fixated on shadowing Eve to notice anyone else around you. 

You're trying to say Diana and I are "coordinating to frame you," which is ridiculous. We're not coordinating; we just both happened to witness different parts of your route that expose you. You were the last one with Eve heading into electrical, and now you're panicking and twisting the timeline because two separate people caught you in a lie. Your whole upper engine explanation is a mess, too—you're trying to make Diana look suspicious for being in a room that you just admitted you were also in.

Diana, I 100% believe you. He's cornered and throwing everything at the wall to see what sticks. Let's vote him out and win this. I'm voting Frank.
